text:
nina.kim: quick heads-up — pricing experiment PX-21 rolled to a subset and the billing engine backfilled discounts incorrectly. Customer: AeroSense (contract AS-2041-02). Looks like $41,760 of prepaid revenue was recognized that should remain deferred. invoices INV-2041-3300 + INV-2041-3301. need revrec guidance and JE before close.

omar.reed: is this the backfill that applied a retro discount for the whole prepaid term?

sarah.guo: yes. experiment logic applied retro discount as a negative invoice line but the commit-proration routine treated the negative as a reduction in outstanding deferred balance and accelerated recognition.

billing-bot: billing-bot: JOB LOG: discount-backfill PX-21 applied run 1885120000; affected invoices listed in /var/log/billing/backfill/1885120000.csv

nina.kim: calc: total prepaid 180,000; recognized in ledger this month 121,760; expected recognized 80,000; over-recognized 41,760. SQL to reproduce: ```sql
SELECT contract_id, invoice_id, line_type, amount, posted_date
FROM billing.invoice_lines
WHERE contract_id='AS-2041-02'
ORDER BY posted_date;
```

omar.reed: thanks. GL impact? we need exact GL lines to create reversing JE.

elaine.ops: propose JE: debit Revenue (GL 4000) 41,760; credit Deferred Revenue (GL 2005) 41,760. Memo: "Reversal of accelerated recognition due to pricing experiment PX-21 discount backfill on AS-2041-02." include backfill log link and invoice ids.

sarah.guo: i'll attach the experiment run notes and add a short postmortem on dev ticket. We should also run a sweep for PX-21 affected contracts.

billing-bot: SWEPT: quick-scan found 4 contracts with similar pattern, estimated exposure = 157,420. Full reconciliation scheduled.

omar.reed: approve JE. @elaine.ops please create JE and post before close. After posting, update deferred revenue schedule and include in close pack with ARR/NRR impact.

elaine.ops: JE created JE# 2041-APR-PX21-007 (pending). Will attach workbook and link to backfill log.

cfo_lucas: flagging two asks: 1) include the ARR/NRR delta and 2) add a one-line note in the close pack describing the pricing experiment and the mitigation plan.

sarah.guo: mitigation: rollback backfill or run corrective negative adjustments that preserve deferred balances. i'll file BE ticket BE-4332 to add a guard that prevents proration when a negative backfill line is present.

billing-bot: TICKET CREATED BE-4332 - Prevent proration on negative backfill lines. Assigned sarah.guo.

nina.kim: uploaded worksheet: https://redwood-internal.s3/finance/AS-2041-02_px21_revrec.xlsx

omar.reed: i'll run GL confirm and post sign-off once JE is live.

elaine.ops: JE posted. updated deferred schedule attached to close pack. Posting note: JE# 2041-APR-PX21-007; reversed 41,760 to Deferred Revenue GL 2005.

cfo_lucas: thanks. Sarah/Omar/Nina — please include the sweep results and next steps in the morning close review.

nina.kim: will do. thanks team :thumbsup:
